Interpretation and data caveats

For TFF, the default net calculation uses the Leveraged Money category. For the Disaggregated report, it uses Managed Money. These are report categories, not a complete view of all market participants. Check the underlying row fields and report type before interpretation. Positions are aggregated and reported with a time lag.
